digest.component_or_area: store push delivery and retry logic
propositions: Core push delivery performs exactly five retriable retry cycles followed by one conditional terminal push that is spent only if the fifth rejection produced a clean merge.

Opt-in strict delivery raises catchable PushDeliveryError with stable machine-readable reasons, suppresses process exit and stream writes in core, and is translated to stderr plus nonzero exit only by the private Python adapter.

All pre-existing library, CLI, MCP, and store-write callers omit strict or reach core with strict=False, retaining best-effort defaults and legacy return behavior while inheriting the corrected retry budget.
Strict delivery does not write ticket events, emit BRIDGE_ALERT, or modify HEAD/working tree; failure reasons are machine-stable and include transport-failure versus policy-decline distinctions.
The implementation is Python-owned and functions identically from brew, pip, and MCP-server installs without requiring workflow-local shell retry logic.
